title: Pool Service Checklist
subtitle: Residential Pool Service: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Pool Service Checklist covers pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature. The residential pool-service coordinator records Residential Pool Service criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Pool Service Checklist keeps Residential Pool Service exceptions visible until the residential pool-service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Pool Service Checklist at residential pool, spa, equipment pad, chemical storage, and access gate. Document pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature identity before Residential Pool Service begins. Compare pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature findings with stated Residential Pool Service criteria; route unresolved Residential Pool Service issues to qualified pool-service reviewer. For Pool Service Checklist, confirm requirements for Residential Pool Service. Ask qualified pool-service reviewer to review Residential Pool Service conditions beyond the residential pool-service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Residential Pool Service, identify responsible parties, residential pool, spa, equipment pad, chemical storage, and access gate, and the linked pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature source.

fields.label: Service interval, target range, and prior reading

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Pool Service facts for pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Pool Service inspection checks
items: Filter pressure, flow, pump, and leak condition
Skimmer, basket, surface, wall, floor, and debris condition
Chemical supply, feeder, storage, and label condition
Gate, barrier, drain cover, and visible deck condition
Adjustment, circulation, retest, and customer restriction

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Residential Pool Service finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Residential Pool-Service Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Equipment cannot circulate or maintain control
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Pool Service when water, chemical, circulation, barrier, visibility, or safe-use control remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Pool Service proof and route unresolved pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature scope to residential pool-service coordinator.
